Application Data.NAME: Blissful Beginnings Wedding Chapel
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Blissful Beginnings Wedding Chapel is a charming and intimate venue located in Springfield, IL, specializing in elegant wedding ceremonies and receptions for small to medium-sized gatherings. The chapel features a beautifully decorated space of 6,000 square feet, accommodating up to 120 guests. Our dedicated team provides personalized services to help couples create memorable moments, including basic wedding planning assistance and coordination. We offer limited on-site catering through a licensed third-party vendor, ensuring that food and beverage options represent less than 10% of our total revenue, with a selection of wine and beer served by trained staff. Safety is our priority, and we have established protocols for crowd control and fire safety, along with appropriate licensing for alcohol service. Additional services include partnerships with local vendors for bridal hair and makeup, enhancing the overall wedding experience while maintaining a focus on risk management and customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2021, a small fire occurred in the kitchen area during a wedding reception caused by a malfunctioning heating element; damages were assessed at $1,500. The venue was able to contain the fire without injury to guests, and all safety protocols were followed. The claim was settled, and the business incurred no additional losses. The status is closed.
